events.verdict: Lopez (MIL) raises his arms up as he turns to face the basket and marginal contact occurs with Young (ATL).

Capela (ATL) raises his left hand up towards the ball and makes some contact with the ball and incidental hand on ball contact with Lopez (MIL) during his legal contest of Lopez's shot attempt at the basket.
Trent Jr. (MIL) places and swiftly removes his hand from Young's (ATL) left arm and the contact during Young's drive is marginal.
Lopez (MIL) establishes himself in a legal screening position and does not deliver any illegal contact when setting the pick on Johnson (ATL).
Daniels (ATL) is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Capela (ATL) legally contests Antetokounmpo's (MIL) jump shot attempt.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) places and immediately removes his hand from Young's (ATL) front during his drive and the contact is marginal.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) legally contests Young's (ATL) jump shot attempt.
Daniels (ATL) reaches in for the ball and makes contact with Lillard's (MIL) upper body, which affects his SQBR with the ball.

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds – Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: Trent Jr. (MIL) makes last contact with the ball prior to it falling out of bounds. Possession is correctly awarded to Atlanta.
Lopez (MIL) legally contests Young's (ATL) jump shot attempt.
Daniels (ATL) and Lillard (MIL) engage during the inbound play and the contact between the two players is marginal.
Young (ATL) brings his hand to the ball and legally brushes it after Trent Jr. (MIL) collects the inbounds pass.
Johnson (ATL) legally contests Lillard's (MIL) driving floater attempt in the paint.
Young (ATL) does not step either foot out of bounds after receiving the ball along the sideline.
Lopez's (MIL) right arm brushes Young's (ATL) front during Young's driving shot attempt and the contact on the play is marginal.
Young (ATL) commits a take foul on Trent Jr. (MIL). The transition take foul rule does not apply to the last two minutes of either the fourth quarter or overtime.
Capela (ATL) establishes himself in Trent Jr.'s (MIL) path and he does not deliver any illegal contact when setting the pick.

Lillard (MIL) brings his left hand to the ball and legally dislodges it from Capela's (ATL) grasp. The contact with Capela's right arm is simultaneous to Lillard's contact with the ball, which results in a dislodge, and is considered incidental.
Bogdanovic (ATL) commits a take foul on Antetokounmpo (MIL). The transition take foul rule does not apply to the last two minutes of either the fourth quarter or overtime.
Lopez (MIL) brings his forearm into Capela (ATL) and delivers contact that affects his layup attempt at the basket.
